#!/bin/bash
python3 - "$1" "$2" <<'PY'
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

target, out = sys.argv[1:3]
CG = "/sys/fs/cgroup"


def sudo(*cmd):
    return subprocess.run(["sudo", *cmd], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout

pid = int(target) if target.isdigit() else json.loads(sudo("runc", "state", target))["pid"]
line = next(l for l in open("/proc/%d/cgroup" % pid).read().splitlines() if l.startswith("0::"))
cgroup_dir = (CG + line[3:]).rstrip("/") or CG
effective = open(cgroup_dir + "/cpuset.cpus.effective").read().strip()
ino = lambda p: sudo("stat", "-c", "%i", p).strip()
view_ino = ino("/proc/%d/root%s" % (pid, CG))
if view_ino == ino(cgroup_dir):
    view_root_dir = cgroup_dir
elif view_ino == ino(CG):
    view_root_dir = CG
else:
    raise SystemExit("the container sees an unknown directory")
names = sudo("ls", "/proc/%d/root%s" % (pid, CG)).split()
json.dump({"cgroup_dir": cgroup_dir, "effective_cpus": effective, "view_root_dir": view_root_dir,
           "view_shows_own_cgroup": view_root_dir == cgroup_dir, "cpuset_cpus_in_view": "cpuset.cpus" in names}, open(out, "w"))
